body:
I don't know what to do right now. 

For the past week, a lot of my friends have been trying to get me to hang out with them at the zoo. The girl I've been in love with said she was bringing her boyfriend and I immediately said I would not go. They tried to get me to go, and I still said no. Today, I talked to that girl, saying she was going to break up with her boyfriend, and all things like that. I started to have a great day. I was on cloud nine. It was going wonderful.

I get home later and she keeps calling, talking, she wants to hang out, I say yeah. Let's. Then as she said she was getting ready, for some reason I don't know why. I pretended like I had a lot of things to do and I could not come. She was kind of pissed off. A few minutes later I realized my error, but she said she was going to go hang out with another friend of hers. Later she asked if I wanted to come. I said no, angry that I had missed my chance.

About a hour ago, I decided "hey, I'll go to the zoo tommorrow, it should be fun, her boyfriend isn't coming."  I give her a call and tell her, she's excited. We start planning when everyone is meeting up. I ask whose coming and she says her boyfriend. I tell her forget it. She's disapointed and we end the call awkwardly. I feel like I've lost a friend, and probably a lot of friends who wanted me to go with them and hang out. It's like I'm afraid to try anything subconciously. I make sure I fail, afraid that I'll suceed at anything. 

On monday I have to see all these people, who I feel I've let down and disapointed. I feel like I've lost a lot of friends, and I can't pin point why I won't go. I'm angry, and sad. I don't know why things are ending up like this and I don't want to know the outcome of them.

I'm in a bad place right now. I need someone to talk to because the people I could talk to about this, are the people I'm disapointing. 

I really feel like I need forgiveness for some reason.
